newsitem.title: UK: NWE low sulphur straight-run fuel oil trades highe.
newsitem.headline: NWE low sulphur straight-run fuel oil trades highe.

text.p: Low sulphur straight-run saw two, possibly three, cargoes sold ex-Zawia at $115 cif NWE.

Sellers in the north were looking for higher numbers on the back of the trades and because crude was holding after its late move higher on Wednesday. But a seller looking for over $150 fob NWE was deemed to be optimistic.

Russian straight-run fuel was still available, although there was mounting speculation about the date of the expected tariff levy. But traders said it was not hampering activity. E-4s were pegged around the mid $130s cif NWE.
